title: DeepSeek Harness profile patch list
description: Permissive schema for $DSH_HOME/profiles/*/cordis.patch.yml. The YAML language server otherwise matches *.patch.yml to the JSON Patch schema, which reports every Cordis loader entry (id/name/config/disabled/insert) as invalid. The loader, not this schema, is the authority; dsh --dump-config-schema describes the full parsed config.
